definitions.gloss: prepared side dishes; ready-made dishes; deli food
definitions.explanation: Pre-cooked dishes sold at supermarkets, department store basements, or specialty shops, meant to be taken home and eaten. Includes items like fried chicken, salads, simmered vegetables, and other everyday dishes.

examples.japanese: お{惣菜|そうざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦{帰|かえ}った→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: I bought some deli food on my way home.

examples.japanese: ⟦スーパー→スーパー：01061_suupaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{惣菜|そうざい}⟦コーナー→コーナー：10865_koonaa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{夕方|ゆうがた}→夕方：01010_yuugata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{混|こ}む→混む：02574_komu⟧。
examples.english: The deli section of the supermarket gets crowded in the evening.

examples.japanese: ⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お{惣菜|そうざい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頼|たよ}る→頼る：02069_tayoru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{気|き}をつけている→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧。
examples.english: On busy days I often rely on prepared dishes, but I try to be mindful of nutritional balance.

notes:
WRITING: The お prefix is a polite/beautifying prefix. The base form ⟦{惣菜|そうざい}→惣菜：05827_souzai⟧ is also used, especially in compound words and on product labels.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{惣菜|そうざい}⟦コーナー→コーナー：10865_koonaa⟧: deli section (of a store)
- お{惣菜|そうざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy prepared dishes
- ⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{惣菜|そうざい}: homemade side dishes
- ⟦デパ{地下|ちか}→デパ地下：08828_depachika⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{惣菜|そうざい}: department store basement deli food

CULTURE: お{惣菜|そうざい} is a major part of Japanese food culture. Supermarkets and convenience stores offer a wide variety, and department store basements (⟦デパ{地下|ちか}→デパ地下：08828_depachika⟧) are famous for high-end prepared foods. Many stores discount お{惣菜|そうざい} in the evening before closing.
